prompt: Weigh tray B on the helper arm's scale. If it is heavier than 1500 g, tell "pass" it is heavy and stop; otherwise have the helper arm put it on the pass.

expect_1_6.planned_paths: 1.2 kg: tray at pass; 2 kg: message and fail; the scale reports kg

why: RoboLang 1.5 cannot read a value from a sensor: inspect observes presence, location and holder only (decision 0036).
